gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-alumni-s: Expressive and loose, Love Ya Like A Sister hugs the baseline with short ascenders. Alumni Sans Pinstripe is the one to read, a plain sans with oversized lowercase and tightly knit words.

Love Ya Like A Sister draws every stroke with one fixed pen width. Alumni Sans SC adds a gentle thick-thin shift and squeezed letters, and that tension between marker-like heft and tidy sans detail is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-anaheim: Anaheim reads dense and smooth, its rounded shapes staying open as the eye slides along. Over many lines, Anaheim feels steady and approachable, while Love Ya Like A Sister stays the loud, level-stroked voice above.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-arsenal: Arsenal has a tall x-height and close-knit letters, with a slight swell in each bowl like pressed glass. Across a long page, Arsenal feels compact and friendly, a quiet counterweight to the ballpoint-pen line of Love Ya Like A Sister.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-arsenal-: Chunky, marker-flat lettering up top, with Love Ya Like A Sister showing no pressure variation at all, then a body with faint thick-thin shifts. Big and short is where it earns its place.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-asimovia: Love Ya Like A Sister is loose, bold and low in its ascenders. Asimovian answers with tall lowercase bodies and a single stroke width, so the pair's strongest quality is how clearly the two stroke habits stand apart.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-basic: Approachable and clean, Basic lifts only gently from small letters to capitals, while the heading's curves never thin out at all. Text settles into an easy rhythm.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-cal-sans: Cal Sans keeps one stroke width through the whole alphabet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height, set under a bolder, looser heading. The pair's best quality is that shared steadiness of line.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-carlito: Modern and compact, Carlito winds its letters tight like thread on a spool. Love Ya Like A Sister is best loud and marker-traced, while Carlito's open rounds and small capitals do the quiet reading work.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-changa: Marker-fat and sturdy, with every o drawn equally thick all round. Love Ya Like A Sister is best at shouting, while Changa's cast-iron-tall lowercase handles the clean, modern talking.
